name: Sodom no Shima ~Night of Blind~
source:
Nankai island exists as a paradise to satisfy human desires since ancient times. It has great scenery, gourmet food and all imaginable pleasures. Innocent girls are being sent there without knowing what fate awaits them.
Asuka travels to this resort island with her bodyguard. However, she gets attention of dangerous people...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
